# Codelynx Digital

> Codelynx Digital is a web design, development and digital marketing agency based in Mirpur, Dhaka, Bangladesh. We design and build custom websites, online stores and web applications, and help businesses grow with local SEO, digital marketing, CRM integration and AI search optimization.

- Office: House-08, Road-22, Block-D, Section-6, Mirpur-1216, Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Phone: +8801580391983
- Contact form: __SITE_URL__/contact/

Every project is designed from a blank canvas around the client's brand and goals. The team covers strategy, design, development and marketing, and supports clients after launch with maintenance and ongoing campaigns.

## Services

- [Custom Web Design](__SITE_URL__/services/custom-web-design/): Custom-designed websites built to turn visitors into customers.
- [E-commerce Development](__SITE_URL__/services/ecommerce-development/): Online stores that drive sales, built on Shopify, WooCommerce, Adobe Commerce, Drupal, Squarespace or Amazon Marketplace.
- [Custom Web Applications](__SITE_URL__/services/custom-web-applications/): Portals, dashboards and business tools built with Laravel, PHP, Vue.js, MySQL and AWS.
- [Website Maintenance](__SITE_URL__/services/website-maintenance/): Security, updates and backups that keep a website fast and safe.
- [Local SEO Services](__SITE_URL__/services/seo-services/): Help nearby customers find the business in search results and maps.
- [Digital Marketing](__SITE_URL__/services/digital-marketing/): Marketing campaigns built around revenue, not vanity metrics.
- [Marketplace Management](__SITE_URL__/services/marketplace-management/): Storefronts, listings and day-to-day management on major online marketplaces.
- [CRM Integration](__SITE_URL__/services/crm-integration/): Set up, connect and automate a CRM such as HubSpot so every lead is followed up.
- [Digital Consulting](__SITE_URL__/services/digital-consulting/): Digital roadmaps tied to measurable return on investment.
- [AI Strategy & Integration](__SITE_URL__/services/ai-strategy/): AI agents and smart automations for everyday business work.
- [AI Search Optimization](__SITE_URL__/services/ai-search-optimization/): Make a website easy for AI assistants to read so the business appears accurately in AI-generated answers.
